I spent a few weeks benchmarking Firecracker guest images and published the harnesses: github.com/GautamTalksDev/mayfly-guest Main finding: most published kernel-stripping advice for Firecracker is stale. Turning ACPI off costs 278ms rather than saving time, because modern Firecracker passes device info through ACPI tables and MPTable booting is now deprecated. Disabling PCI breaks root disk discovery entirely, since CONFIG_PCI
